title: Zero count when no term is satisfied
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ coordinates, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. If no term of $\varphi$ evaluates to $-1$ at $x$, then the number of terms evaluating to $-1$ at $x$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: No term in the formula evaluates to $-1$ at $x$
